corridor.line: I seen a girl on a one-way corridor
stanza: I seen a girl on a one-way corridor
For all the world like an urban toreador
She had wheels on, on her feet
Well, the cars do the usual dances
Same old cruise and the kerbside crawl
But the rollergirl, she's taking chances
They just love to see her take them all

corridor.line: There were voices down the corridor
stanza: There she stood in the doorway
And I was thinkin' to myself
"This could be Heaven or this could be Hell"
Then she lit up a candle
And she showed me the way
There were voices down the corridor
I thought I heard them say
